# ZM Printing & Design Ltd.

> 100% Export-Oriented Garment Printing & RMG Accessories Manufacturer in Bangladesh.
> Quality | Creativity | Solution

## Overview
ZM Printing & Design Ltd. is a comprehensive apparel trims, textile screen printing, continuous dye sublimation, liquid silicone badges, and ultrasonic NXP welding manufacturing company based in Ashulia, Savar, Dhaka, Bangladesh.

- **Website**: https://zmprintingbd.com/
- **Founded**: 2013 (Modern export-standard facility)
- **Facility Area**: 30,000 SQFT multi-floor production complex
- **Workforce**: 300+ dedicated employees (135 women, 120 men, 35 technical staff, 10 executive administration)
- **Monthly Output**: 2,336,000+ units/month (printed panels, badges, transfers, and packaging)
- **Sampling Turnaround**: 48 hours for physical strike-offs and rapid prototypes

## Verified Manufacturing Divisions & Capabilities
- **Screen Printing**: Automatic carousels and manual long-table lines handling plastisol, water-based high solids, discharge, reflective, crack, puff, glitter, and metallic prints.
- **Sublimation Printing**: Precision Epson dye sublimation printers with continuous rotary calender heat presses for sportswear jerseys, allover apparel panels, and cap crowns.
- **Direct to Film (DTF)**: High-resolution photographic heat transfer stickers with elastic hot-melt TPU powder backing.
- **Direct to Garment (DTG)**: Multi-color direct inkjet textile printing on cotton garments.
- **Liquid Silicone & 3D Badges**: Medical-grade liquid silicone injection, high-definition 3D molded emblems, zipper pullers, and micro-recessed perimeter sewing canals.
- **NXP Sonic Welding**: High-frequency ultrasonic vibration welding achieving 10,000mm hydrostatic waterproof seals without needle perforations.
- **UV Digital Flatbed**: Instant LED-curable UV printing with spot gloss varnish on rigid acrylic, leather, and metal accessories.
- **Garment Trims & Packaging**: High-tenacity sewing threads, alloy buttons, smooth sliding zippers, GRS-certified hangers, offset hangtags, biodegradable polybags, and embossed leather denim patches.

## Compliance, Lab Testing & Certifications
- **OEKO-TEX® Standard 100**: Class I / Class II chemical safety compliance.
- **amfori BSCI**: Audited social compliance and ethical labor standards.
- **Sedex SMETA (4-Pillar)**: Labor rights, health & safety, environment, and business ethics.
- **In-House Testing Laboratory**: X-Rite spectrophotometers (Delta E < 0.8), AATCC 61 4A wash fastness testing (45+ industrial cycles), crocking fastness testing, and AQL 1.5 pre-shipment inspections.
